description: Find local AI computers and graphics cards by budget, memory and type. Returns price, measured tok/s, value (tok/s per 1,000 of currency), when the price was checked, and the page URL. Prices are checked once a day.

benchmark.description: Speed to use: small = Llama-2 7B Q4_0 (default, most results), large = gpt-oss-120b (needs 64GB+).

in_stock_only.description: Leave out machines a store reports as out of stock.

kind.description: machine = complete computer, gpu-card = graphics card only (needs a PC). Default any.

max_price.description: Highest price in the region's currency.

min_memory_gb.description: Least memory (unified memory or VRAM) in GB, e.g. 128.

region.description: us = prices in USD, eu = prices in EUR. Default us.

sort.description: value = tok/s per 1,000 (default), price = cheapest first, speed = fastest first.

name: search_machines
title: Search machines
